purpose: Observe PostCSS package-root behavior through bounded JSON requests without importing candidate JavaScript in the trusted node:test process.

operations.inspect: Return package metadata, root export kinds, and processor version.
operations.parse: Parse bounded CSS and return a cycle-free node projection, canonical CSS, and selected source positions.
operations.mutate: Apply an allowlisted JSON tree mutation then return CSS and projection.
operations.process: Run allowlisted JSON plugin descriptors and return final CSS, warnings, and async behavior.
